agent_explanation: Emergency preemption (N at t147) fires while EW is green (step 146). At step 147 EW is forced to yellow with the emergency active, then at step 148 NS is forced green. This preempting transition goes EW-yellow directly to NS-green, giving 0s of all-red (need 1s) and truncating EW yellow to 1s (need 6s). The controller's emergency hold path bypasses the normal yellow-timing and all-red-clearance interlock.
